name: worksphere-monorepo
description: WorkSphere - Multi-Tenant Project Management & Workflow Automation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:analytics"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:analytics && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
